PURPOSE: Request lineage for PING: per-external-call receipt shape (timing, usage, cost attribution), client-asserted session grouping (id/path/name), retry-inside-receipt semantics. Supports proofs 3/10/13/14.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: RequestReceipt: canonical hashable record of one external call {receipt_id, request_id (client idempotency UUID), target, request_digest sha256(canonical req bytes), response_digest sha256(canonical resp bytes), status_code, started_at, ended_at, latency_ms, ttft_ms?, usage{input,output,cached_input,cache_write_5m/1h,thinking,modalities?,web_search?}, cost_usd, cost_source: provider_reported|computed|unknown, model, provider, actor_ref (hashed key id), session_id, session_path, session_name, properties{...}, retry_count, fallback_used?, body_ref?}. Helicone proves the attribution shape + sessions-as-projection + retries-invisible-to-log; PING adds the digests (trust-kernel computes) and a body-purge path. Sessions become projection-kernel GROUP BY session_id rollups; no session lifecycle needed.
